mapper.select: select d.D_Id from SYS_Position_User pu left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_Id=p.P_Id left join SYS_Department d on d.D_Id=p.D_Id where pu.U_Id=#{uId} and (pu.PU_Main_Duty=true or pu.Pu_Duty=true) and d.D_Project_Auth='04'
select d.D_Id from SYS_Position_User pu left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_Id=p.P_Id left join SYS_Department d on d.D_Id=p.D_Id where pu.U_Id=#{uId}

select c1.C_Name as dCompanyName, mn.* from SYS_Department mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.D_Company_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Position po on po.D_Id=mn.D_Id left join SYS_Position_User pu on po.P_Id=pu.P_Id where pu.U_Id=#{uId} order by mn.D_Sort asc

select mn.D_ID from SYS_Department mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.D_Company_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Position po on po.D_Id=mn.D_Id left join SYS_Position_User pu on po.P_Id=pu.P_Id where pu.U_Id=#{uId} order by mn.D_Sort asc
select c1.C_Name as dCompanyName, mn.* from SYS_Department mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.D_Company_Id=c1.C_Id where mn.D_ParentID='0'
select c1.C_Name as dCompanyName, mn.* from SYS_Department mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.D_Company_Id=c1.C_Id where mn.D_Code=#{dCode}
